actual_rule_observed: Under the starter's explicit sidebar config there is no working hide flag: neither frontmatter sidebar.hidden nor entry-level hidden:true removed an explicitly-listed page; the page built and its nav link stayed in place with neighbours unmoved.

frontmatter_used.description: Probe page testing the config-level hide flag.
frontmatter_used.title: P4 Hidden Probe

notes: Canonical P4 run against the default starter setup (explicit sidebar array) tested TWO hide-flag variants, both with the page listed in the config: (a) frontmatter sidebar.hidden:true -> page still listed in nav at flattened index 1, page still built (dist/p4-hidden/index.html); (b) config entry { label, slug, hidden:true } with plain frontmatter -> identical result, link present, neighbours unmoved. The @astrojs/starlight 0.42.3 sidebar schema (dist/schemas/sidebar.js) defines no hidden key for explicit entries, and its navigation code (dist/utils/navigation.js) only filters sidebar.hidden inside treeify(), which is used exclusively for autogenerate directories. matched_documented_rule=false: hide behaviour is documented in the official docs but the docs could not be loaded (browser service upstream 401); observed behaviour under explicit config contradicts the expectation that a hide flag removes the entry. A frontmatter sidebar.hidden page inside an autogenerate directory WAS confirmed hidden in the EXTRA-AUTOGENERATE run.
